subject: Kickoff - excited to get going
body: Really looking forward to this workstream. The proposed data model looks solid and the timeline feels achievable. Let's keep the momentum from the pitch going.

subject: Sprint 1 recap
body: Good first sprint overall. Only note is our data team was slower than expected getting you warehouse access, hopefully that doesn't repeat next sprint.

subject: Data access still pending
body: Following up, the warehouse access issue from last week is still not fully resolved on our end, which I know is pushing your timeline too. Chasing it internally.

subject: RE: segmentation logic question
body: Got your question about the segmentation logic, but I need a clearer answer than what was in the doc, it read as more ambiguous than I'd like this deep into the sprint.

subject: RE: Sprint 2 demo
body: Demo was fine, though I noticed the churn model still isn't using the updated segments we discussed three weeks ago. Can we make sure that's in for Sprint 3? Don't want it to slip again.

subject: Following up on churn model fix
body: Checking in on the churn model fix from last week's demo feedback. Haven't seen an update and we're now into Sprint 3.

subject: Timeline concerns
body: I'm a little concerned we're now two sprints behind where the original plan had us. I understand things come up, but I'd like a clearer view of how we get back on track before I have to explain this upward. Can we set up a call this week instead of waiting for the regular cadence?

subject: Still no plan
body: It's been a week since our call and I still don't have the recovery plan you said would be ready by Friday. This is becoming a pattern I need to flag more formally.

subject: Following up again
body: This is the second time I've had to ask for the updated project plan after saying I needed it by end of week. I don't want to escalate this, but I need to see a concrete recovery plan, not just an apology, by Monday.

subject: Recovery plan received
body: Got the recovery plan Monday as promised, and it looks reasonable on paper. I'll withhold full confidence until we've actually hit two sprints on the new dates, but this is a step in the right direction.
